description: This header file provides function declarations and macros for replacing standard libc functions, mainly for use in Linux environments. It includes custom implementations for string operations, integer parsing, and memory functions, with a focus on safety in dynamic linker contexts.

methods.name: my_strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: my_strncmp
methods.description: Compares two strings up to a specified length.

methods.name: my_strtoui
methods.description: Parses a non-negative integer from a string.

methods.name: my_uint_len
methods.description: Returns the length of an unsigned integer in decimal.

methods.name: my_uitos
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to a string.

methods.name: my_strchr
methods.description: Finds a character in a string.

methods.name: my_strrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: my_read_hex_ptr
methods.description: Reads a hexadecimal value from a string.

methods.name: my_read_decimal_ptr
methods.description: Reads a decimal value from a string.

methods.name: my_memset
methods.description: Fills memory with a constant byte.

methods.name: my_strlcpy
methods.description: Copies a string with size limit.

methods.name: my_strlcat
methods.description: Concatenates a string with size limit.

methods.name: my_isspace
methods.description: Checks if a character is whitespace.
